# The packages published to nuget.org, one package ID per line.
#
# This is the set that IsPackable=true in src/, and it is deliberately NOT "everything under
# src/". Alberto.Admin and Alberto.Admin.Postgres build and are tested but are parked — see the
# admin-surface note in CLAUDE.md. Scripts that walk public API must use this list rather than a
# src/* glob, or they will treat the parked surface as shipping API: Alberto.Admin carries a
# 327-line PublicAPI.Unshipped.txt that must never be promoted to Shipped.
#
# Blank lines and #-comments are ignored by readers.

Alberto.Messaging.Postgres
Alberto.Postgres
